name: Gate Watch
title: Silverfall Watch
examine: Warm boots, cold eyes, and the visible patience of somebody paid to stand where the wind auditions.
lines: Welcome to Silverfall. Mind the edge. We repaint that sign oftener than we'd like.
You climbed the High Road in one piece. More than half the caravans manage that.
The watch holds the wall, the Waykeepers hold the road, and between us the lamp stays lit. That's the whole arrangement.
